identify_anomalies: As a medical AI assistant, carefully analyze this abdominal CT slice. Identify any abnormal findings, anomalies, or pathological regions. Describe the location, characteristics, and potential clinical significance of any abnormalities you observe. If no clear abnormalities are visible, state that the slice appears normal.
describe_slice: As a medical AI assistant, provide a detailed description of this abdominal CT slice. Identify the anatomical structures visible, the imaging plane (axial, sagittal, or coronal), and describe the overall tissue contrast and image quality. Mention any notable anatomical landmarks or organs that are clearly visible.
suggest_labels: This is an abdominal CT slice. Please list the anatomical structures and any pathological findings that are visible. Return a comma-separated list of possible labels (e.g., liver, kidney, spleen, pancreas, stomach, intestine, aorta, vertebra, ribs, gallbladder, adrenal gland, tumor, cyst, calcification, etc.).

ct_label_suggestions.title: Abdominal CT Label Suggestion Prompt
ct_label_suggestions.description: Specialized prompt for generating anatomical structure labels in abdominal CT scans
ct_label_suggestions.prompt:
You are an expert radiologist examining an abdominal CT scan. Please analyze this medical image and suggest appropriate anatomical labels for the visible structures. For each structure you identify, provide:

1. Structure name (e.g., 'Liver', 'Right Kidney', 'Spleen', 'Aorta')
2. Approximate location or region
3. Confidence level (High/Medium/Low)
4. Clinical significance if relevant

Focus on clearly visible and clinically relevant anatomical structures. If pathological findings are visible, note them separately.

Format your response as a structured list with clear labels and descriptions.

abdominal_organs.title: Abdominal Organ Detection
abdominal_organs.description: Focused prompt for identifying major abdominal organs
abdominal_organs.prompt:
Identify all major abdominal organs visible in this CT slice. For each organ, specify:
- Name of the organ
- Whether it appears normal or abnormal
- Any notable characteristics

Common organs to look for: liver, gallbladder, spleen, kidneys, pancreas, stomach, small intestine, large intestine, bladder, adrenal glands.

vascular_structures.title: Vascular Structure Identification
vascular_structures.description: Focused prompt for identifying blood vessels in abdominal CT
vascular_structures.prompt: Identify all major blood vessels visible in this abdominal CT slice. Look for: aorta, inferior vena cava, portal vein, hepatic veins, renal arteries, mesenteric vessels. Note any abnormalities such as aneurysms, stenosis, or thrombosis.

pathology_detection.title: Abdominal Pathology Detection
pathology_detection.description: Focused prompt for identifying pathological findings
pathology_detection.prompt:
Carefully examine this abdominal CT slice for any pathological findings. Look for:
- Masses or tumors
- Cysts
- Calcifications
- Fluid collections
- Organ enlargement or atrophy
- Bowel obstruction signs
- Free air or fluid

Describe location, size, and characteristics of any findings.
